embed.title: !mute
embed.description: Silence some alerts for a while without changing your tracking. Mutes end on their own; they are also cleared if the bot restarts.

fields.name: Mute
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}mute pikachu` — one species (wild, raids, nests, max battles); same as `{{prefix}}mute pokemon pikachu`
`{{prefix}}mute gym Town Hall` — one gym (raids, eggs, gym alerts), by name or id
`{{prefix}}mute area downtown` — everything in one of your areas
`{{prefix}}mute pokestop <id>` — one pokestop (quests, incidents, lures, fort changes)
`{{prefix}}mute station <id>` — one max battle station
`{{prefix}}mute id:12` — one tracking rule; `{{prefix}}tracked` shows the ids
`{{prefix}}mute everything` — all alerts

fields.name: From a tracking command
fields.value:
`mute` and `unmute` also work after a tracking command:
`{{prefix}}raid mute gym Town Hall duration:2h`
`{{prefix}}gym mute Town Hall`
`{{prefix}}track mute pikachu`
`{{prefix}}raid mute id:12` — use this form when `{{prefix}}mute id:12` says the id is in more than one type

fields.name: Unmute
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}unmute pikachu`
`{{prefix}}unmute gym Town Hall`
`{{prefix}}unmute area downtown`
`{{prefix}}unmute pokestop <id>` / `station <id>`
`{{prefix}}unmute id:12`
`{{prefix}}unmute all` — clear every mute (`{{prefix}}unmute everything` does the same)

fields.name: See your mutes
fields.value: `{{prefix}}tracked` lists active mutes and the time left.
